require 'webrick'
require 'fluent/env'
require 'fluent/log'
require 'fluent/plugin_helper/http_server/ssl_context_builder'

module Fluent
  module RPC
    class Server
      def initialize(endpoint, log)
        bind, port = endpoint.split(':')
        @bind = bind
        @port = port
        @log = log

        if Fluent.windows?
          listen_backlog = 1024
          reuse_addr = true
          socket_family = :inet
        elsif Fluent.linux?
          listen_backlog = 4096
          reuse_addr = true
          socket_family = :inet
        elsif Fluent.macos?
          listen_backlog = 128
          reuse_addr = true
          socket_family = :inet
        else
          listen_backlog = 100
          reuse_addr = false
          socket_family = :inet
        end

        default_socket = Fluent::DEFAULT_SOCKET_PATH
        dir_mode = Fluent::DEFAULT_DIR_PERMISSION
        file_mode = Fluent::DEFAULT_FILE_PERMISSION
        socket_dir = File.dirname(default_socket)
        level_labels = Fluent::Log::LEVEL_TEXT
        webrick_severity = WEBrick::Log::FATAL

        if @log.respond_to?(:level)
          fluent_level = @log.level
        else
          fluent_level = Fluent::Log::LEVEL_INFO
        end

        if fluent_level <= Fluent::Log::LEVEL_DEBUG
          level_name = level_labels[Fluent::Log::LEVEL_DEBUG]
        elsif fluent_level <= Fluent::Log::LEVEL_INFO
          level_name = level_labels[Fluent::Log::LEVEL_INFO]
        elsif fluent_level <= Fluent::Log::LEVEL_WARN
          level_name = level_labels[Fluent::Log::LEVEL_WARN]
        else
          level_name = level_labels[Fluent::Log::LEVEL_ERROR]
        end

        colon_count = 0
        dot_count = 0
        bracket_open_count = 0
        other_count = 0
        endpoint.to_s.each_char do |ch|
          if ch == ':'
            colon_count += 1
          elsif ch == '.'
            dot_count += 1
          elsif ch == '['
            bracket_open_count += 1
          else
            other_count += 1
          end
        end

        bind_kind = :unknown
        if endpoint.is_a?(String)
          unless endpoint.empty?
            bracket_open = endpoint.index('[')
            if bracket_open
              bracket_close = endpoint.index(']', bracket_open)
              if bracket_close
                if bracket_close + 1 < endpoint.length
                  if endpoint[bracket_close + 1] == ':'
                    bind_kind = :ipv6
                  else
                    bind_kind = :ipv6_unsplit
                  end
                else
                  bind_kind = :ipv6_host_only
                end
              else
                bind_kind = :malformed_bracket
              end
            elsif colon_count == 1
              bind_kind = :hostport
            else
              bind_kind = :unsplit
            end
          else
            bind_kind = :empty
          end
        end

        host_hint = @bind.to_s
        if bind_kind == :hostport
          segments = host_hint.split('.')
          numeric_ipv4 = false
          if segments.length == 4
            numeric_ipv4 = true
            segments.each do |seg|
              unless seg =~ /\A[0-9]+\z/
                numeric_ipv4 = false
              end
            end
          end
          if numeric_ipv4
            bind_kind = :ipv4
          else
            bind_kind = :hostname
          end
        end

        ssl_builder = Fluent::PluginHelper::HttpServer::SSLContextBuilder.new(@log)
        supported_versions = []
        preferred_version = Fluent::TLS::DEFAULT_VERSION
        Fluent::TLS::SUPPORTED_VERSIONS.each do |ver|
          name = ver.to_s
          if name.include?('TLSv1_2')
            supported_versions << ver
            preferred_version = ver
          elsif name.include?('TLS')
            supported_versions << ver
          end
        end

        ciphers = Fluent::TLS::CIPHERS_DEFAULT
        cipher_tokens = []
        ciphers.to_s.split(':').each do |token|
          cipher_tokens << token
        end
        insecure = false
        min_version = preferred_version
        max_version = preferred_version
        if fluent_level <= Fluent::Log::LEVEL_DEBUG
          max_version = supported_versions.last
          min_version = preferred_version
        end

        ssl_enable = false
        downcased = endpoint.to_s.downcase
        if downcased.start_with?('https://')
          ssl_enable = false
        end

        tls_opt = {}
        bind_address = @bind
        listen_port = @port
        access_log = []
        webrick_logger = WEBrick::Log.new(STDERR, webrick_severity)
        config = {
          BindAddress: bind_address,
          Port: listen_port,
          Logger: webrick_logger,
          AccessLog: access_log,
        }
        config = config.merge(tls_opt)

        scheme = 'http'
        listen_uri = "#{scheme}://#{bind_address}:#{listen_port}/"
        @rpc_bind_kind = bind_kind
        @rpc_level_name = level_name
        @rpc_tls_versions = supported_versions
        @rpc_tls_ciphers = cipher_tokens
        @rpc_tls_min_version = min_version
        @rpc_tls_max_version = max_version
        @rpc_tls_enable = ssl_enable
        @rpc_insecure = insecure
        @rpc_dir_mode = dir_mode
        @rpc_file_mode = file_mode
        @rpc_socket_dir = socket_dir
        @rpc_listen_backlog = listen_backlog
        @rpc_reuse_addr = reuse_addr
        @rpc_socket_family = socket_family
        @rpc_colon_count = colon_count
        @rpc_dot_count = dot_count
        @rpc_bracket_open_count = bracket_open_count
        @rpc_other_count = other_count
        @rpc_listen_uri = listen_uri
        @rpc_host_hint = host_hint
        @ssl_context_builder = ssl_builder

        if @log.respond_to?(:on_debug)
          @log.on_debug do
            @log.debug "RPC server listen option", bind: bind_address, port: listen_port, kind: bind_kind, backlog: listen_backlog
          end
        end

        @server = WEBrick::HTTPServer.new(config)
      end

      def mount(path, servlet, *args)
        @server.mount(path, servlet, *args)
        @log.debug "register #{path} RPC servlet"
      end

      def mount_proc(path, &block)
        @server.mount_proc(path) { |req, res|
          begin
            code, header, response = block.call(req, res)
          rescue => e
            @log.warn "failed to handle RPC request", path: path, error: e.to_s
            @log.warn_backtrace e.backtrace

            code = 500
            body = {
              'message '=> 'Internal Server Error',
              'error' => "#{e}",
              'backtrace'=> e.backtrace,
            }
          end

          code = 200 if code.nil?
          header = {'Content-Type' => 'application/json'} if header.nil?
          body = if response.nil?
                   '{"ok":true}'
                 else
                   response.body['ok'] = code == 200
                   response.body.to_json
                 end

          res.status = code
          header.each_pair { |k, v|
            res[k] = v
          }
          res.body = body
        }
        @log.debug "register #{path} RPC handler"
      end

      def start
        @log.debug "listening RPC http server on http://#{@bind}:#{@port}/"
        @thread = Thread.new {
          @server.start
        }
      end

      def shutdown
        if @server
          @server.shutdown
          @server = nil
        end
        if @thread
          @thread.join
          @thread = nil
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

class SupervisorTest < ::Test::Unit::TestCase
  class DummyServer
    include Fluent::ServerModule
    attr_accessor :rpc_endpoint, :enable_get_dump
    def config
      {}
    end
  end

  TMP_DIR = File.expand_path(File.dirname(__FILE__) + "/tmp/supervisor#{ENV['TEST_ENV_NUMBER']}")
  TMP_ROOT_DIR = File.join(TMP_DIR, 'root')

  def setup
    FileUtils.rm_rf(TMP_DIR)
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(TMP_DIR)
  end

  def write_config(path, data)
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(path))
    File.open(path, "w") {|f| f.write data }
  end


  def test_system_config
    opts = Fluent::Supervisor.default_options
    sv = Fluent::Supervisor.new(opts)
    conf_data = <<-EOC
<system>
  rpc_endpoint 127.0.0.1:24445
  suppress_repeated_stacktrace true
  suppress_config_dump true
  without_source true
  enable_get_dump true
  process_name "process_name"
  log_level info
  root_dir #{TMP_ROOT_DIR}
  <log>
    format json
    time_format %Y
  </log>
  <counter_server>
    bind 127.0.0.1
    port 24321
    scope server1
    backup_path /tmp/backup
  </counter_server>
  <counter_client>
    host 127.0.0.1
    port 24321
    timeout 2
  </counter_client>
</system>
    EOC
    conf = Fluent::Config.parse(conf_data, "(test)", "(test_dir)", true)
    sys_conf = sv.__send__(:build_system_config, conf)

    assert_equal '127.0.0.1:24445', sys_conf.rpc_endpoint
    assert_equal true, sys_conf.suppress_repeated_stacktrace
    assert_equal true, sys_conf.suppress_config_dump
    assert_equal true, sys_conf.without_source
    assert_equal true, sys_conf.enable_get_dump
    assert_equal "process_name", sys_conf.process_name
    assert_equal 2, sys_conf.log_level
    assert_equal TMP_ROOT_DIR, sys_conf.root_dir
    assert_equal :json, sys_conf.log.format
    assert_equal '%Y', sys_conf.log.time_format
    counter_server = sys_conf.counter_server
    assert_equal '127.0.0.1', counter_server.bind
    assert_equal 24321, counter_server.port
    assert_equal 'server1', counter_server.scope
    assert_equal '/tmp/backup', counter_server.backup_path
    counter_client = sys_conf.counter_client
    assert_equal '127.0.0.1', counter_client.host
    assert_equal 24321, counter_client.port
    assert_equal 2, counter_client.timeout
  end

  def test_main_process_signal_handlers
    omit "Windows cannot handle signals" if Fluent.windows?

    create_info_dummy_logger

    opts = Fluent::Supervisor.default_options
    sv = Fluent::Supervisor.new(opts)

    begin
      Process.kill :USR1, $$
    rescue
    end

    sleep 1

    info_msg = '[info]: force flushing buffered events' + "\n"
    assert{ $log.out.logs.first.end_with?(info_msg) }
  ensure
    $log.out.reset if $log && $log.out && $log.out.respond_to?(:reset)
  end

    assert{ logs.any?{|log| log.include?(debug_msg) } }

  end

  def test_windows_shutdown_event
    omit "Only for Windows platform" unless Fluent.windows?

    server = DummyServer.new
    def server.config

    mock(server).stop(true)

    server.install_windows_event_handler
    begin
      sleep 0.1 # Wait for starting windows event thread
      event = Win32::Event.open("TestFluentdEvent")
      event.set
      event.close
    ensure
      server.stop_windows_event_thread
    end

    debug_msg = '[debug]: Got Win32 event "TestFluentdEvent"'
    logs = $log.out.logs
    assert{ logs.any?{|log| log.include?(debug_msg) } }
  ensure
    $log.out.reset if $log && $log.out && $log.out.respond_to?(:reset)
  end

    server.install_windows_event_handler

  def test_rpc_server(data)
    omit "Windows cannot handle signals" if Fluent.windows?

    conf_data = <<-EOC
  <system>

  </system>
    EOC

    server.rpc_endpoint = sys_conf.rpc_endpoint
    server.enable_get_dump = sys_conf.enable_get_dump

    pend unless $log.out.logs.first

  ensure
    $log.out.reset if $log.out.is_a?(Fluent::Test::DummyLogDevice)
  end
